For men, row planting has created a lot of advantage. For one the improved seeds are not wasted because they are properly covered with soil and they are also put properly on the ground with a chance of growing evenly on the land. The seeds get fertilizer directly and that make it grow faster. It makes weeding easier because of the herbicide and also even handpicking is easier because you can see it clearly. When it grows the yield is very good and that creates opportunities for better food security and income for the household.

Improved cows may be a lot of work when they take care of them but the milk, and dairy products are very profitable for women. Since the man will not ask her the income from the sale of dairy products, she can use it as she pleases. [you mean she can sell the caw if she wants?] no that is the man’s job. She cannot sale the animal she has to keep taking care of it. the decision to sale it is his if she is married. If not she may decide but has to be accompanied to the market to sale it because she will get tricked in terms of pricing, s she is not skilled negotiator.

They don’t have. If there is anything new in farming practices my father is the first to know and he will take me with him not my sisters. [why not your sisters?] what would she do with that knowledge? Farming is for the man. In the culture they also have to stay home.
